notes.title: Okashi Towers Full Release
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing Story Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/af23b9b2da90fa0512d1387d8967bac7caa2fa45.gif[/img]

With the full version of Okashi Towers comes the long awaited Story Mode. Learn how to play with the new tutorials and earn achievements while playing through a diverse set of single player story maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/6aa5cd0b04fd9194874f9b5efa209896aba0557a.png[/img]

Meet new characters along the way and battle through interesting challenges to save your friends and defeat your enemies.

[h2]Major Game Overhaul[/h2]

Version 1.0.0 is a major overhaul of Okashi Towers. This update includes a vast amount of new features, quality of life enhancements and a complete art makeover. Below are some of the new features:

[list]
[*] Tutorial System
[*] UI Overhaul
[*] World previews/filtering
[*] Achievements
[*] HUD updates
[*] Resolution scaling
[*] New music/sfx
[*] Unit Animation Improvements
[*] Multiple new events for the World Builder
[/list]

Join the discord to see the full release notes: https://discord.gg/Us79pKspse

notes.title: Hotfix Version - 0.9.1
notes.content:
This patch fixes a few small bugs and adds some small features to the game.

[list]
[*] Bug: Fixed bug where you could delete objects in the world builder that were in a separate layer than the selected one
[*] Big: Fixed Trigger and Event windows showing up behind decoration objects
[*] Feature: For the spawn event, npc units can be set to aggressive or passive
[/list]

notes.title: Version - 0.9.0
notes.content:
[h1]World Builder Script Objects[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/6afae3d7aeb3c01b0fb83906b242472ae0e916a1.gif[/img]

Version 0.9.0 introduces a new initial set of objects in the World Builder that can customize the way a game is played. Each script object has customizable parameters to control what happens during a match. These can be categorized into three different types Triggers, Events, Game Settings. These new objects are found in the World Builder in the Object Layer at the end of the list (Press the left arrow once).

[h2]Triggers[/h2]

A trigger is a type of script object that can start other script objects when certain conditions are met.

[h3]Timed Trigger[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/dbd2e29bd195db845d934e192657e71e49954f47.png[/img]

The Timed Trigger will call all events in the event list once the set amount of time has passed. This trigger can be set to repeat or only happen one time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/dfc9059a64ef857d88c2c3011bff6d9eea20e9e5.gif[/img]


[h3]Collision Trigger[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/e5ac43a8dc76786f509011b05d30cb9634560ced.png[/img]

The Collision Trigger will trigger all of the events when a unit has collided with the trigger. This can be customized so that only certain types of units will activate the trigger, it can even be set to only trigger for specific teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/4ad48ab0675a8b9cc96afe43c965d1334dae8424.gif[/img]


[h2]Events[/h2]

An Event is a type of script object that performs some type of action. These are not called on their own and must be called by some type of Trigger.

[h3]Dialogue Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/72dd984839c73d22cdcffae387ebc67b83cdef22.png[/img]

The dialogue event will display a dialogue message that can be seen by all players. This can be customized to have a specific Theme, Voice, Speaker, and whether the speaker has a name or not. All languages can be customized with a localized message. To perform multiple phrases of text, separate the text by the "|" (pipe character).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/6afae3d7aeb3c01b0fb83906b242472ae0e916a1.gif[/img]


[h3]Game End Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/e1e95c3f69d76f27f15409788d6bb7f58550eaca.png[/img]

A Game End Event can customize how the game will end and specify who Won and who Lost the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/d6b098d902e057a35c972a2bb4d42d41eea3a830.gif[/img]

[h3]Spawn Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/4cf2a08b87c6fccc2b771344fdc28f00896e4e9d.png[/img]

A Spawn Event can spawn in multiple units and assign them to certain players/teams/NPC's. 

PLAYER - will spawn the unit for every player
TEAM - will spawn a unit for each team and assign it to a random player on the team
FRIENDLY_NPC - will spawn an npc unit for each team
ENEMEY_NPC - will spawn a single enemy npc
PLAYER_TEAM_X - will spawn a unit for every player on the X team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/04aec0a349c1e2a60e06835f87d0a6619d579cc1.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Settings[/h2]

There is currently only one game setting object. This is the PVE script object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/de81253a7e0d234c910449d8bffeccab4b7305bb.png[/img]

Under normal circumstances, a game started with only one team will end immediately because the default win condition is that there is only one team left. By using the PVE Block a game can be started with one team and the default win condition is ignored so that a customized win condition can be set.

[h1]BOT Difficulty[/h1]

The BOT difficulty can now be set in the custom lobby underneath the BOT name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/3c435aa72fdf87359ecbad4c9a8776d56d53b8cd.gif[/img]

[h1]Lobby Ready Button[/h1]

A lobby ready button has been added so that a game will not be started until everyone is actually ready. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/9d953eed3824c2dd404f36edc017b3424a7715bf.gif[/img]


[h1]Other[/h1]

[list]
[*] Hosts can now change bot factions and colors
[*] Changed the cursor to be more visible
[*] Languages in the settings menu are now displayed in the translated names instead of locale code
[*] Bug: Fixed bug where towers could now be warped with the Witch special (Was introduced with tower upgrades allowing towers to be selected)
[/list]

notes.title: Version - 0.8.2
notes.content:
[h1]Tower Upgrades![/h1]

As part of 0.8.2 it is now possible to upgrade towers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/49d07be693da93122af898341297ee38919df3a2.gif[/img]

Towers can now be selected to display their upgrade menu. Tier 1 towers can be upgraded to Tier 2. Tier 2 towers can be upgraded to Tier 3. Tier 3 towers can be upgraded to the new set of Tier 4 towers.



[h1]New Area of Effect Towers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/6af133b4f5931aa2d5d8059379c1865486abcc56.gif[/img]

Each faction has their own unique Area of Effect Tower at Tier 4. These towers deal damage to all enemies in the surrounding area. They also provide more resources than Tier 3 towers. However, their range is reduced and they are much more susceptible to ranged unit/tower attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/8441613a7eebf63631a963f4941b56d42fba513f.gif[/img]



[h1]New Support Towers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/4c0a18d164e6b7b522e35db568eac8e4691275f1.gif[/img]

As an alternative to Area of Effect Towers, Tier 3 towers can upgrade to a Support Tower. These towers are common across factions. These special support towers provide enhancements to all surrounding friendly units (Even teammate units). However, they do not provide resources and do not damage other units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/53ce61dd60d14e3ba4be648f0e1981112fd22a7a.gif[/img]

Health Tower - Heals units over time

Shield Tower - Boosts defense for a short period of time

Sword Tower - Boosts attack for a short period of time

Speed Tower - Boosts speed for a short period of time


[h1]Unit Stat Cards![/h1]

It is now possible to view unit stats by hovering over the unit in either the item shop, or in their upgrade menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283356/99a25708b45b3d808018516bd4c3ab4dc03195bd.gif[/img]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Victory Screen
[*] Increased Cauldron spawn time
[*] New AI system that also supports unit upgrades
[*] Bug: fixed issue where possessed units still count for the original owner until the possessed unit died
[*] Small UI changes
[/list]



Join the discord to give suggestions/bug reports:
https://discord.gg/Us79pKspse

notes.title: Version - 0.8.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

This update introduces a new way for gathering resources. There is a new map object now, the "Candy Cauldron". You can find these scattered around different maps and they are now available to be placed in custom maps using the World Builder! 

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/587279917046038529/1168270885208211486/CandyCauldron.gif?ex=6551280c&is=653eb30c&hm=91ae2d8a006e5a64f3082eb850605a0e0ca7a06f0297f52e44c3e233896cb8a8&[/img]

Destroying a Candy Cauldron will reward you with extra resources. They will eventually respawn as well. Many players have asked for different ways to actively gather more resources, in addition to the current passive way (building more towers). 

Other small bug fixes were part of this update. I hope you enjoy the changes!

-Blekoh

(Join the community discord to leave feedback/suggestions/bug reports https://discord.gg/Us79pKspse )
